outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
finding: Delivery by Caesarean section was more frequent in the IBD cohort, and most elective Caesarean sections were obstetrically indicated.
mod_finding: Delivery by Caesarean section was more common in IBD patients (RR 1.45, CI 1.16−1.81, p = 0.0021); emergency Caesarean section delivery was equally likely (RR 1.26, CI 0.78−2.07, p = 0.3).
